mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_problem_status (user_id, problem_id, status, first_ac_time, solve_source, accepted_submission_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{problemId}, 2, #{firstAcTime}, #{solveSource}, #{submissionId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 2, accepted_submission_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(first_ac_time) < user_problem_status.first_ac_time OR (VALUES(first_ac_time) = user_problem_status.first_ac_time AND user_problem_status.accepted_submission_id IS NULL) OR user_problem_status.first_ac_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(accepted_submission_id) ELSE user_problem_status.accepted_submission_id END, solve_source = CASE WHEN VALUES(first_ac_time) < user_problem_status.first_ac_time OR (VALUES(first_ac_time) = user_problem_status.first_ac_time AND user_problem_status.accepted_submission_id IS NULL) OR user_problem_status.first_ac_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(solve_source) ELSE user_problem_status.solve_source END, first_ac_time = CASE WHEN VALUES(first_ac_time) < user_problem_status.first_ac_time OR (VALUES(first_ac_time) = user_problem_status.first_ac_time AND user_problem_status.accepted_submission_id IS NULL) OR user_problem_status.first_ac_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(first_ac_time) ELSE user_problem_status.first_ac_time END
INSERT INTO user_problem_status (user_id, problem_id, status, performance_note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{problemId}, 0, #{note}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE performance_note = VALUES(performance_note)

INSERT INTO user_problem_status (user_id, problem_id, status, first_ac_time, solve_source, accepted_submission_id) SELECT fa.user_id, #{problemId}, 2, o.submitted_time, fa.platform, fa.submission_id FROM oj_first_ac fa JOIN oj_submission o ON o.id = fa.submission_id WHERE fa.platform = #{platform} AND fa.external_problem_key = #{externalProblemKey} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 2, accepted_submission_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(first_ac_time) < user_problem_status.first_ac_time OR user_problem_status.first_ac_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(accepted_submission_id) ELSE user_problem_status.accepted_submission_id END, solve_source = CASE WHEN VALUES(first_ac_time) < user_problem_status.first_ac_time OR user_problem_status.first_ac_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(solve_source) ELSE user_problem_status.solve_source END, first_ac_time = CASE WHEN VALUES(first_ac_time) < user_problem_status.first_ac_time OR user_problem_status.first_ac_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(first_ac_time) ELSE user_problem_status.first_ac_time END
